summary: The Expo app treats the Android emulator host 10.0.2.2 as loopback through the one shared isLoopbackHost helper, matched exactly: 10.0.2.20, 10.0.2.2.example.com and 110.0.2.2 are refused. No behaviour changes; tests pin the rule and the helper names the stricter native Android release rule.

desktop.reason: The desktop does not dial phones and does not call isLoopbackHost or cleartextRefusal; only a comment in src/shared/transport-security.ts changed.

nativeAndroid.reason: Native Android keeps its stricter release rule (CleartextPolicy.kt and network_security_config.xml: localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1 only; 10.0.2.2 in debug builds only), unchanged by this work.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data is read or written differently; saved machines are not rewritten.

updateRelease.reason: No runtime code changed, so no OTA or binary release carries a behaviour change.

automated: vitest tests/unit/transport-security.test.ts and tests/unit/connection-security.test.ts: 10.0.2.2 is loopback and local, the near-misses are refused and read as plain.
jest apps/mobile transport-gate.test.ts: a store build dials ws://10.0.2.2 and refuses the near-misses.
notExercised: No emulator or phone was run; the change is tests and a comment only.
